H2a_A.query: the last registered minute query strictly before the event, reading only release<=q_i
H2a_A.task: fine identity given the event size or coarse composition; not an unconditional set forecast
H2a_A.normalisation: per community c given K_c: exp(sum_{j in A_c} l_j) / e_{K_c}(exp l_c); community log-probabilities are summed
H2a_A.units: K_c=0 and K_c=|c| are deterministic; an event whose communities are all deterministic is not a unit

wrong_time.head: the fixed C+H+S conditional identity head
wrong_time.selection: nearest legal FIT donor by time distance; no target, seizure or score is read
wrong_time.no_donor: locally not estimable; the criteria are never relaxed

H2a_B.prefix: the genuinely observed prefix of the event, in occurrence order

coordinates: (1-p0)-weighted normalised positive standardised log-IQR conditional mean
S_A.reference: the FIT reference state distribution at the identical query, C and MC noise
S_A.primary_output: per case window, per coordinate signed mean difference against matched controls
S_A.overall: sqrt(0.5*spatial + 0.5*mean over the three morphology families of mean squared standardised differences)
S_A.caveat: non-negative by construction; it is not a positivity verdict and no latent axis is picked

S_B.query: the last legal minute query at least 5 minutes before EEG onset
S_B.predictor: the frozen interictal H2a-A contact head on the same m and C
S_B.target: clinical onset [0,10] seconds, CAR, 1-150 Hz baseline robust-z broadband activation
S_B.primary: within-community Spearman on identical valid contacts, equal weight over qualified communities
S_B.auxiliary: all-contact Spearman, retained as the legacy convention with a cross-community bias caveat
S_B.forbidden: substituting continuous broadband energy into the IED set likelihood

S_C.note: a missing denominator limits S-C only; it does not block S-A or S-B

no_new_seizure_head: the first package adds no seizure-supervised head
